channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Elton Brand | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Elton Brand from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Cuttino Mobley on Corey Maggette, Elton Brand
item.description:
Cuttino Mobley:

“And people don’t understand, if you look at my numbers for that season with the Clippers, I could have been an All-Star that year. But again, I don’t care. I don’t care because Elton Brand was an All-Star. Corey Maggette averaged 20. We made the playoffs. We beat the Denver Nuggets in five. It was the first time the Clippers had ever been out of the first round. That was my All-Star.”

Cuttino Mobley on Corey Maggette, Elton Brand, Oct 5, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Cuttino Mobley on Corey Maggette, Elton Brand, Shaun Livingston, Sam Cassell
item.description:
Cuttino Mobley:

“There were times, man, where I'd score like 15 first quarter, 12 first quarter, and then I’d feel that—and I have to give the ball up. You know what I’m saying? Like, I always wanted to be part of the group, never lead the group—until I started getting older. Then I was fine with leading, but letting everybody else shine. That was my role with the Clippers—with Elton Brand, Corey Maggette, Shaun Livingston, and Sam Cassell.”

Cuttino Mobley on Corey Maggette, Elton Brand, Shaun Livingston, Sam Cassell, Oct 5, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Draymond Green on Al Jefferson, Elton Brand
item.description:
Ahmed/The Ears/IG: BigBizTheGod ??: Kenyon Martin says he could name 200 players that are better players than Draymond Green:

“That man’s individual body of work is cool but I can list 200 players that’s better than Draymond Green, is he better than LeMarcus Aldridge, Al Jefferson or Elton Brand I can go all day”

Draymond Green on Al Jefferson, Elton Brand, Jul 17, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: LeBron James on Elton Brand
item.description:
“Give a lot of credit to [general manager] Elton Brand and the things that they're doing here. Obviously, Doc has always won pretty much wherever he's been. We'll see as the season goes on. There's going to be a lot of teams in the Eastern Conference playing championship basketball down the stretch. I know they believe that they're one of those teams.”

LeBron James on Elton Brand, Jan 28, 2021. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Brett Brown on Elton Brand
item.description:
Brett Brown:

“They’re inaccurate. And all of that stuff, we learned five days ago, somebody had written or spoken about he wanted to maybe look at other options, as well. I think it’s just part of the world we live in. It’s not shocking or surprising to me personally that these things come up. I get it. And I think that Elton Brand, in the role that he has – I’m thrilled to have Elton as my general manager – that’s certainly all in his wheelhouse more than mine.”

Brett Brown on Elton Brand, Nov 27, 2018. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Markelle Fultz on Elton Brand
item.description:
Adrian Wojnarowski:Raymond Brothers, the agent for Sixers guard Markelle Fultz, tells ESPN:

“I have given no indication to Elton Brand or anyone else that Markelle would prefer to be traded. My focus is to get Markelle healthy. End of story.”

Markelle Fultz on Elton Brand, Nov 22, 2018. Source: Twitter @wojespn.

item.title: Adam Silver on Elton Brand
item.description:
Adam Silver on Elton Brand [2/2]:

“He was an All-Star player, a respected teammate and a thoughtful voice in our league.”

Adam Silver on Elton Brand, Oct 21, 2016. Source: Twitter @DerekBodnerNBA.

item.title: Brett Brown on Elton Brand
item.description:
Molly French:Brett Brown on bringing Elton Brand in as a player:

“It's deeper than putting a suit on him and thinking we can get the value out of him that we want. Down 20, what happens on bench. At halftime, when coaches are in other room, what is said. If the game comes down to the wire...”

Brett Brown on Elton Brand, Jan 4, 2016. Source: Twitter @MollyFrenchCSN.
